ops.title: claude-sdk backend + core-first api_auth subscription guarantee (v0.10.0)
ops.description:
Approved plan (session plan file: acct-06/plans/can-claude-agent-lucky-thompson.md, v3 post-inversion). Two features, one commit, core-first:

1. `RunSpec.api_auth: bool = false` (wire, `#[serde(default)]`) + `ExecPlan.env_unset` emitted by the four exec plan builders from shared per-provider key-var consts (claude: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN; codex: OPENAI_API_KEY/CODEX_API_KEY; gemini: GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY; agy: GEMINI_API_KEY/ANTIGRAVITY_API_KEY — gemini/agy consts shared with probe.rs EnvAny). `route.rs` capabilities gains `api_key_vars`. All three hosts apply the strip (rust env_remove; go mergeEnv seed-skip; python filtered merge). Default strips → subscription billing guaranteed; `api_auth=True` restores inheritance. Probes intentionally keep seeing ambient env.
2. `ClaudeSdkBackend` (`claude-sdk`, extra `sdk`, claude-agent-sdk>=0.2, verified v0.2.122): Python-only in-process backend (MLX precedent — core never learns the provider), registered FIRST in BACKENDS_BY_NAME + takes `general`; thin host (schema/resolve via core with provider="claude"; SDK strip by blanking env values to "" since options.env only overlays). Cross-check test narrowed to core-known subset.

Release: tag v0.10.0 after landing; watch release-pypi/crates/go.

single commit landed, CI green, v0.10.0 tagged, all three release workflows green
